empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills
drawer.comingSoon: Coming soon — this import method isn't wired up yet.

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Stored as data and disabled until you read and enable it — not executed as instructions until then.
file.dropHint: Drag a .md or .zip file here, or

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Must point at raw markdown. A GitHub/GitLab/gist page URL is rewritten to its raw form automatically; HTML pages are refused.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. It's stored as data and left disabled until you read the body and enable it — enabling is the vetting step.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

edit.descriptionHint: Write this as an instruction — it's the skill's interface.

risks.heading: Review before enabling
risks.intro: This body came from outside the workspace and will become part of an agent's prompt. Nothing here blocks the import — the skill lands disabled, and these are the spots worth reading first.
risks.hidden_text: Contains HTML comments or invisible characters — text you can't see in the preview. Invisible characters were removed.
risks.instruction_override: Contains text addressed at the model rather than at you (e.g. overriding earlier instructions).
risks.external_url: Links to other hosts. Check where they point before enabling.
risks.credential_reference: Mentions environment variables or key-shaped strings.
risks.data_uri: Embeds a data: or base64 blob.
risks.oversized: Long enough to crowd out the rest of the prompt.

config.heading: Configuration
config.enabledHint: Whether this block is added to agents' prompts.
config.changeHint: Optional — shown against this edit in Versions. Only recorded when the body changes.
config.changePlaceholder: Tightened scope rule; cap at 5 high-signal findings

previewTab.heading: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
previewTab.empty: This skill has no body yet.

stats.agentsEmpty: Not attached to any agent yet.
stats.categoryEmpty: No findings attributed to this skill yet.
stats.caveat: A run attaches several skills and no table links a finding to the one that caused it, so findings and accept rate are credited to every skill on the run — read them as a signal, not a measurement. Pull frequency is a share of runs that used any skill, not of all runs.

versions.heading: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.empty: No snapshots yet — the first body edit records one.
